scope: Searches use the exact movement, chant, mirror, circuit and combat engine. Goal both heroes leave the start island is weaker than WIN; proving it impossible proves WIN impossible.

checks.name: Crate removed
checks.mutation: Replace the only initial o by floor. Keep both heroes, both monsters, both mirrors, the button and gate.
checks.goal: Both heroes x >= 8 (east of the initial island)

checks.name: Ray gate held shut
checks.mutation: Replace gate at source-map (6,6) by a permanent wall and remove its gate device; preserve all other floor, actors, mirrors and the button.

notes: The Merchant must move the first mirror from (4,6) to (5,6). The only safe mainland landing east of this mirror is (11,6).
The button is adjacent to the only safe first-island launch cell (5,12): substituting a monster for the crate kills the departing hero.
The button itself reflects to water while aligned with the unadjusted mirror, so the last hero cannot safely leave by teleporting directly from the button.
A voluntary south step of the Bard from (5,11), after the crate is on its button, drags the crate into water (4,13), removes the weight and shuts the ray gate. A Merchant push preserves the weight.

limitations: These checks establish necessity of the crate and of opening the gate. They do not establish uniqueness or minimum length of the full solution.
